edges.description: Triglyceride accumulation in cardiomyocytes impairs cardiac energy metabolism and produces the lipid-storage cardiomyopathy.
Triglyceride accumulation in coronary vascular cells drives the coronary artery disease component of the syndrome, in parallel with the myocardial arm.
Lipid-storage cardiomyopathy progresses to the adult-onset severe heart failure that dominates the clinical presentation.
This is the direct enzymatic measurement of the reduced ATGL activity mechanism node.
edges.source: Reduced ATGL Activity Without PNPLA2 Mutation
